{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
valid_sales = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Check if channel and customer_segment are balanced
# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
tab = pd.crosstab(valid_sales['channel'], valid_sales['customer_segment'])

# Compute conversion rates by channel
c_conversion = valid_sales[valid_sales['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
p_conversion = valid_sales[valid_sales['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

diff_rate = c_conversion - p_conversion

# Print results
tab, c_conversion, p_conversion, diff_rate"}
